name: Egg Maiden
summary: Your dream- to become a traveling merchant. The problem? You've noone to manage your hotel your parents left you five years ago. In this world, those who tread the line of poverty become slaves for the wealthy. You've finally saved up enough for your own to manage your hotel, but life had different plans. A slave fell into your lap. She's a little odd though, just a little. She lays eggs that hatch into monster girls?
